name: session-pulse
description: Session Pulse above the prompt box: context window with a /compact nudge, 5-hour and weekly limits, prompt clocks, session, daily and weekly cost, a /pulse command and a chime when a long turn ends.

compactSoftK.title: Compact nudge (K tokens)
compactSoftK.description: Context size, in thousands of tokens, at which the band suggests /compact (yellow). Capped at 50% of a smaller window.

compactHardK.title: Compact urge (K tokens)
compactHardK.description: Context size, in thousands of tokens, at which the suggestion turns red. Capped at 70% of a smaller window.

warnPercent.title: Yellow from (%)
warnPercent.description: Bars turn yellow from this percentage.

alertPercent.title: Red from (%)
alertPercent.description: Bars turn red from this percentage.

longTurnSeconds.title: Long turn (seconds)
longTurnSeconds.description: A prompt that runs at least this long ends with a toast, a notification and the chime.

playSound.title: Chime on long turn
playSound.description: Play sounds/done.wav when a long turn ends.
